title: Academy My Courses
summary: Course catalog page with a hero banner featuring illustration and search, tab navigation for My Courses/Trending/Free Courses, 3-column card grid of course cards with instructor avatars, star ratings, chip tags, and progress indicators. Bottom section has CTA banner cards for certificates and popular courses, plus a 'Today's Free Courses' row of simple text cards.

layout.columns: Full-width hero, then 3-column card grid, then 2-column CTA banners, then 3-column free courses
